name: CarPlay head unit
blurb: Modern touchscreen unit in the OEM aperture.
body: The centre stack comes apart from the console upward. The manual instrument panel sequence covers the finish panels and the heater console that have to move first.
watch: A CarPlay unit peaks near 10 A with the screen bright and the amplifier working — nothing like the OEM radio it replaced. The RADIO circuit is a 15 A fuse and is the right home for it.
Keep the constant memory feed and the switched feed separate. Bridging them is how a head unit flattens a battery over a weekend.
The OEM aerial is amplified and needs its power lead connected, or FM reception collapses.

elec.why: RADIO, 15 A, accessory-switched — the circuit designed for exactly this load.

figs.c: Instrument panel — components and removal order
